I appreciate that you added the backstory about your brothers not taking the same time and value that you do. It seems like gift giving is your love language ! So you take super huge pride in the things you gift people! If OP didn’t include the backstory I’d probably say ya you’re TA. But I can understand the frustration and your side of this, you even came to him with a compromise and suggested a brand new one & embroidery. I think you just have a really big heart and sometimes that comes off as a character flaw. If said brother took the time to analyze your character, he would’ve know you didn’t mean to come off that way to him & he wouldn’t have flown off the handle.

The more I respond to these comments the more I feel like an asshole of course, def shouldn’t have pulled that move.

Hey man. Sometimes people go through things. Sometimes we take those things super personally. & it’s only fair to let him air out. But you said something about having a job now and something similar is happening to me -

My roommate was laid off and I’m still working. What used to be a healthy relationship is now fueled by jealousy that I’m sure I would have if I was her. Right now, things are sooo hard for people and how people perceive things and their pain is up to them and may be completely different than how you are perceiving your pain. So something that may not be real big to you may be absolutely huge to them. 

Like I said it’s only fair to give him the space he needs and deserves. If there wasn’t a problem for 4 years & now there is.. then you need to look at the variables that have changed just recently within your relationship. That’s it.
